description:
Logging today has two unconnected paths: fixed-portion chips and the "Log something else" form (FuelPanel.tsx:167-206), which takes a label and two numbers and remembers nothing it wasn't told. This ticket is the single entry point the other fuel tickets feed into.

- A bottom sheet opened by "+ Log food" on the Fuel page and the Start card. Two tabs:
  - "Your foods": search over saved items (T-050), substring plus token matching like ExercisePicker's matchesQuery, never fuzzy. Pick one, then set the portion with ×0.5 ×1 ×1.5 ×2 chips and a ±0.25 stepper (T-045). A live preview shows all four macros scaled. The CTA says exactly what gets logged ("Log 1.5 × Chicken breast"). Creating a food is an explicit last row ("+ New food "chick…""), shown only when nothing matches: the same rule that fixed ISS-008 for exercises.
  - "Just numbers": label plus four fields, carbs and fat optional ("not given"), and a "Save as one of my foods" checkbox.
- "When" row: defaults to now on today, or to the day the Fuel page's stepper is on. Changing it stamps loggedAt (T-047).
- The entry still stores absolute numbers. Editing a saved food later never rewrites entries already logged (RULES 1).
- Chips keep one-tap logging at ×1. Holding a chip opens this sheet on that food.

Mockup: https://claude.ai/artifact/CD3dbZS6upyEbpCcv25c2g (Log, interactive: pick a food and a portion).
title: One "Log food" sheet: pick a saved food, set a portion and a time, or just type numbers
